summary:
Our Idea: Planetary Analog Explorer App
Our project is a mobile application designed to help users discover places on Earth that are geologically similar to specific regions on Mars and the Moon.
The user can select a location on Earth through an interactive map, and the application identifies its closest planetary analog on Mars or the Moon. It then displays information about both locations, including their geological characteristics, rock types, mineral composition, and similarities and differences.
The app also explains why these comparisons are scientifically useful, helping users understand planetary geology, study extraterrestrial environments, and identify Earth locations that can serve as natural laboratories for future space exploration and research.
Our main goal is to make planetary geological comparisons easier, faster, and more accessible through one interactive platform.
